sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (various slabs mentioned; starts below ₹3L up to ₹25L+ implied)

room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (<₹5L); 1% or Single AC Room, whichever higher (≥₹5L)
room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room taken

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in base policy

sub_limits.display: Cataract: 10% of SI max ₹50k/eye; Mental illness: 25% of SI max ₹3L/yr
sub_limits.note: Cataract surgery and specified mental illnesses (schizophrenia, bipolar, depression, OCD, psychosis) are sub-limited

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible on base plan; daily cash optional cover has a 1-day deductible

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credits; no optional add-on to reduce further

specific_disease_waiting.note: Table A (24mo): cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, calculus, etc. Table B (36mo): joint replacement, ARMD, named mental illnesses, neurodegenerative disorders

maternity.display: Optional add-on (24mo wait); Normal ₹40k, C-sec ₹60k, max 10% of SI
maternity.note: Limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; SI must be above ₹3L; newborn covered up to 90 days at 10% of SI

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 200% of SI (20%/yr first 5 yrs, 10%/yr thereafter)
cumulative_bonus.note: Alternatively, policyholder may choose No Claim Discount (up to 50% premium discount) instead of CB; CB reduces by one slab per claim year

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of SI — unrelated illness only
restoration.note: Restored SI available only for illness unrelated to the claim that triggered restoration; available for SI ≥₹3L; not carried forward

pre_hosp.note: Combined pre+post capped at 10% of SI

post_hosp.note: Combined pre+post capped at 10% of SI

day_care.note: As per standard day care definition

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under Specific Permanent Exclusions; Home Care Treatment covered only for epidemic/pandemic up to 10% of SI or ₹30k

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered as per standard definitions; no separate sub-limit stated

organ_donor.display: Covered (harvesting expenses + 10% SI lump sum if insured is donor)
organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered; separate lump sum benefit of 10% SI if insured person is the donor (after 12 months continuous coverage)

ambulance.note: 0.5% of SI per event (max ₹2,500); 1% of SI per policy period (max ₹5,000)

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy (haematological), HIFU, etc.

consumables.display: Not covered (non-medical items excluded per Annexure-1)
consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure-1; no optional rider for consumables mentioned

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly limited to India; all treatment must be taken in India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not renewals or portability

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, OPD treatment, sleep disorders/apnoea, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric O2, external congenital anomalies, hearing aids, growth hormone therapy

optional_riders.display: Maternity & Newborn cover, Daily Cash Allowance on hospitalisation
